tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Homology of disjoint union] ↗ lem:boundary-composition-zero 1. ch2:2.6\group Singular Homology

If $X=\coprod _\alpha X_\alpha $ is the decomposition into path-components, then \[ H_n(X)\cong \bigoplus _\alpha H_n(X_\alpha ). \]
Proof

\sketch Every singular simplex has path-connected image, so the chain complex splits as the direct sum of the chain complexes of the components.

□
